beats.care: Commuting at midday? Carry water, wear light cotton and avoid long walks in the afternoon sun.
beats.what: Santacruz recorded 38°C on Sunday, 4.9°C above normal. Monday's high was forecast around 36°C under clear skies.
beats.why: The monsoon withdrew early. Experts point to a dry September, a rainfall deficit and El Niño.

cards.body: Sunday's 38°C came within 0.6°C of it, as per IMD data.
cards.caption: October record, set Oct 17, 2015

cards.body: IMD Mumbai Director Bikram Singh says highs will drop gradually from Tuesday. No heatwave alert has been issued, but hot and humid weather continues.
Even Monday morning's minimum was 29°C, so the nights aren't cooling the city much either.

opts: What heat? I'm used to it
cards.q: How are you beating the heat?

opts: It was 4.9°C hotter than usual for that date
It broke the all-time record by 4.9°C
cards.q: What does '4.9°C above normal' mean for Sunday's 38°C?
cards.why: 'Normal' is the long-term average for that date, so Sunday was far hotter than a usual October day.

hook: Mumbai came within *0.6°C* of its October heat record

learn.t: The monsoon left Mumbai on October 3, about a week before its usual exit date.
